notes.title: Patch 0.9.9.2
notes.content:
Added a large set of new character names.
Implemented “trash loot” for dungeons to help mitigate situations where no bosses are defeated.
Introduced a grace period before Happiness penalties start stacking for not participating in dungeons or not receiving loot. This system may evolve in the future.

notes.title: Patch 0.9.9.1
notes.content:
Fixed issues with the "Sort By" function, particularly with "Sort by: Charges."

Rare occurrences of an unexpected reset to Day 0 during gameplay have been observed. A fix has been deployed to prevent this from happening.

notes.title: Patch 0.9.9.0
notes.content:
Raids with more than 40 members should now be impossible.

Major change regarding dungeon "Charges":
Everything has been migrated from a global value (based on the sum of the raid members' Availability stats) to a per-character charge value that is directly linked to each character’s Availability stat. This change should prevent several issues and allow multiple raids to run smoothly.

Save compatibility should be maintained, but issues may occur due to changes in the character table structure.
